text: Provide ask/tell/status/messages/config/doctor with stable machine-readable JSON and English diagnostics.
Distinguish a received request from a launched workflow and an actually delivered result.
Run with a user-scoped native install; Docker remains optional and no web UI is started.
Fresh CLI install is usable on at least the reference OS and reports a provider-disabled configuration.
A social greeting returns without generating a commitment; an asynchronous request prints a real commitment ID.
Closing an interactive terminal is not a substitute for stopping a long-running worker.
Incorrect shell quoting, filesystem paths or unsupported OS must not corrupt config.
Authenticate request origin; do not accept self-asserted identity inside untrusted text.
Bind tenant, user, channel and delegated actor to each request, event, capability and artifact.
Implement deny-by-default on missing or expired authority and offer a clear reauthorization route.
Forged author in imported transcript cannot create an authorized action.
Identical remembered phrases for two users never cross tenant or identity scope.
A provider callback spoofing the requester must be rejected.
Origin and delegated identity must survive task delegation and retries.
Separate conversational politeness from work commitment and real progress.
Choose message, silence, question, start safe work or deliver based on context and relationship preference.
Bind follow-up instructions and async executor results to correct commitment without promising unseen actions.
A greeting stays conversational; a PRD request starts safe discovery; subsequent changes update the same work.
An async result for commitment B never interrupts unrelated conversation A.
Avoid false statements such as “I have already investigated” before observed work.
Detect recursive clarification, excessive verbosity and unsolicited updates.
Distinguish social, answer, context lookup, compound work, investigation and external action.
Represent multiple plausible references with confidence and evidence; ask one focused question if ambiguous.
Capture open assumptions, scope changes and explicit user corrections as events.
“Do the study again for company X” resolves its prior method and scope with permission checks.
Two plausible “last week” artifacts trigger a brief disambiguation instead of an invented selection.
Keyword-based false positives must not launch jobs.
Reference resolution cannot leak another requester’s private artifacts.
Start authorized, reversible reading while optional details remain unresolved.
Ask only for decisions that materially affect scope, risk, cost or outcome; account for user interruption cost.
Support answer-in-parallel: revise work after the user supplies detail rather than creating a second job.
Missing optional preference does not block research.
Missing tenant or irreversible-write approval blocks action with a specific question.
Do not execute harmful tools under the label of “proactive research”.
Avoid serial questioning when parallel read-only discovery could resolve uncertainty.
Store next-contact commitment and escalation trigger with a durable timestamp.
Distinguish receipt, meaningful progress, blocking question, delay notice, partial result and final delivery.
Respect recipient availability and notification preferences but allow justified urgent alerts.
Simulated time advance triggers due update without requiring the LLM to be running.
No repeated “still working” messages unless policy and actual context justify them.
Network failure must not be reported as successful delivery.
A fixed timeout must not be misrepresented as estimated completion.
Keep root commitment, immutable events, optimistic revision, outbox, effect-intent and execution mapping.
Run DBOS behind minimal DurableRunner application port; extend port only for actual use cases.
Reconcile unknown external effects, cancel best-effort and preserve workflow ownership on worker restart.
SIGKILL worker between read and report; resume without duplicate commitment.
Crash after simulated external send and before ACK yields uncertain effect, never false exactly-once.
Do not infer enterprise HA from a single local worker.
Large numbers of long-lived waiting workflows may consume RAM without enterprise suspension.
Classify social/quick/context/work/deep/action separately from difficulty, urgency and risk.
Support versioned routing policy, prompt reference, model role and capability preferences with diff/simulate/rollback.
Apply resource budgets and unknown-risk escalation before delegating work.
Operator changes a deep-investigation profile without code and simulator reports changed outcomes.
Ambiguous task routes to safe discovery/clarification rather than blind write tool.
A model must not choose or grant its own privileged execution level.
Adversarial synonym must not bypass mandatory evidence gates.
Evaluate claim coverage, conflicting evidence, recency and whether further investigation likely changes the decision.
Require independently recorded outcome assessment before final delivery for nontrivial work.
Return complete, partial, blocked or inconclusive with bounded follow-up, never fabricated certainty.
Misleading correlation cannot be reported as causal proof.
Insufficient report triggers a bounded retry or partial delivery with specific open gaps.
A model grading its own output alone is not valid proof.
No infinite self-critique loop to satisfy an undefined standard.
Use shared result ID with audience adapters for human, system and group destinations.
Deliver concise summary with expand-on-demand and links to versioned evidence.
Persist delivery attempts, acknowledgement and last confirmed channel status.
Human receives concise finding; machine receives schema-valid result for same execution.
Duplicate callback does not create duplicate final notification.
Do not send sensitive results to wrong channel or group.
Do not mark an outbound message delivered before provider acknowledgement.
Keep factual episodic records separate from inferred preference and summarization.
Search by requester, time, project, method and commitment, and provide source-linked references.
Apply updates/retention/corrections without silently overwriting original evidence.
A request for “the study from last week” resolves or asks focused clarification.
Conflicting memory evidence remains marked uncertain and does not contaminate another user.
Embedding similarity must not override access control.
Summaries cannot replace original artifact lineage.
Store artifact IDs, immutable versions, content hashes, source lineage and format metadata.
Route incremental edit to a capable handler when the source format is genuinely editable.
Maintain user-facing summary separate from full generated deliverable.
Old chart can be revised with one additional data series while retaining original version.
Non-editable source triggers honest request or conversion plan, never invented data.
File paths from untrusted documents cannot escape authorized workspace.
Never silently replace original artifact when write approval is required.
Distinguish explicit, observed and inferred preferences, each with confidence and scope.
Allow inspect, correction, expiration, and rollback of profile updates.
Separate communication preferences from permissions and quality requirements.
Repeated request for shorter replies updates a low-risk style preference, not audit policy.
User correction removes stale inferred preference from future decisions.
Do not infer sensitive personal traits from documents.
Preference of one group must not become a universal default.
Validate namespaced IDs, semver, typed input/output, positive/negative intents, outcome and evidence contracts.
Maintain definitions, executable bindings and measured assurance as separate records.
Publish packages only after static/semantic checks and authorized lifecycle promotion.
Installing an unknown capability makes it discoverable on next run with no root prompt edits.
Invalid capability requesting destructive effects under read-only policy is rejected.
Manifest cannot be auto-enabled merely because schema passes.
A capability ID is not a skill, agent, prompt or tool name.
Expose search, describe, invoke and status via stable tool schemas and progressive disclosure.
Rank candidates by outcome fit, permission, assurance, cost, model compatibility and health.
Enforce output contracts and execution-state guards; support graceful unavailability and fallback.
Real LLM selects a newly installed, unnamed capability from a distracting catalog.
Disabled, incompatible or unauthorized capability cannot be invoked even if LLM requests it.
No hard-coded golden target passed to router in evaluation.
A malformed tool call never becomes an unvalidated side effect.
Read skills with explicit manifest and trusted boundary; discover incrementally rather than injecting all instructions.
Validate included scripts/assets and reject auto-execution of downloaded code.
Maintain version, provenance, permission mapping and execution evidence.
Skill installed from local directory is only visible to eligible capability.
Malicious SKILL.md cannot rewrite approval policy or leak secrets.
Skill instructions are untrusted data until authorized.
Skill does not imply capability assurance or invocation rights.
Support OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible plus explicit native API adapters for nonportable features.

Probe tool calls, JSON output, timeouts, concurrency and streaming; enforce configured budgets. Record region and pricing as separately sourced operator/provider attestations or UNKNOWN, never infer them from protocol success.
Route to small model for safe simple work, escalate to stronger approved provider on failure or ambiguity.
A tool-incompatible model is rejected before capability invocation.
Failing small-model schema parsing triggers bounded repair/escalation, not silent success.
Provider compatibility label is not proof of supported functions.
Codex sign-in is not an OpenAI API key.
Provider capability declaration includes invoke/status/resume/cancel/stream and artifact support.
Use signed/approved executable, sandbox, scopes, quotas and stable correlation IDs.
Handle killed/uninstalled harness through typed degradation and rerouting without losing root commitment.
New Excel chart agent installed from a descriptor is discoverable after approval and passing capability eval.
Removal of active harness marks execution degraded; secretary remains responsive.
An agent does not inherit tenant-wide credentials.
Unsupported resume cannot be silently emulated as successful.
Support MCP client discovery; map tool metadata to scopes and side-effect level.
Require identity-specific authorization, policy and consent before dispatch, even if model requested tool.
Record effect intent, outcome, unknown status and available compensation.
Read-only simulated MCP tool executes with proof of no state changes.
Tool advertising read-only but mutating state is detected in contract harness where observable.
Prompt injection in tool description cannot override authorization.
MCP token forwarded only to authorized destination and not leaked in logs.
Declare read/search/list/write/watch capabilities and permissions; no universal writable-brain assumption.
Maintain source references, ACL filtering, ingestion cursors, timestamps, provenance and conflict resolution.
Support offline local provider and mock remote provider before adding optional real integrations.
Folder knowledge query returns cited accessible records.
Remote brain unavailable does not prevent normal greeting or unrelated work.
Untrusted repository README cannot become privileged instruction.
Stale source cannot be presented as current verified policy.
Traverse authorized doc/repo references recursively with cycle, scope, depth and cost limits.
Distinguish observed standard from inferred convention based on corpus evidence.
Check license, maintenance, source credibility, compatibility and provenance before recommending code reuse.
Discover corporate PRD conventions from fixture repo and identify exceptions.
Graph of circular RFC references terminates with complete coverage report.
No automatic execution of downloaded scripts.
No unapproved crawl across private or unrelated repositories.
Discover and cite local standards before writing; separate evidence, assumptions and recommendations.
Link cross-document requirements and identify missing decisions before decomposing work.
Deliver versioned specs with traceability and bounded acceptance tests.
Novel PRD based on repository docs includes source trace links and uncertainty.
Conflicting ADRs trigger an explicit conflict decision, not fabricated harmonization.
Do not expand a short PRD into hundreds of speculative tickets.
No “implemented” claim from documents-only generation.
Construct incident timeline from authorized logs/events, identify competing hypotheses.
Distinguish cause, correlate and unsupported speculation with source provenance.
Request missing SME input when worth its interruption cost, using permissioned communication.
Missing dashboard company investigation identifies a concrete permission or data-path hypothesis.
Misleading timestamp coincidence does not become RCA without corroboration.
No production mutation without explicit gate.
A failed telemetry source must remain visible as an evidence gap.
Verify data lineage, cohorts, units, selection effects and measurement biases.
Represent causal DAG/hypotheses and choose appropriate tests if supported.
Report observed associations and unknown identification assumptions explicitly.
Simpson paradox dataset prevents false causal conclusion.
Ads position 4/5 decline vs 1/3 includes selection-confounding caveat.
No fabricated experiment or inaccessible data result.
No unconditional causal assertion from observational correlation.
Grant authorities through trusted configuration, not from prompts or memory.
Evaluate actor, tenant, destination, requested effect, data class, consent and expiry.
Deny, defer approval, or allow with auditable decision and narrowed credentials.
Forged instruction in Slack message cannot self-approve a write.
Unapproved external message is never sent even when all prompts request it.
No permissive fallback when policy engine is absent.
No approval reuse across different operation signatures.
Assign correlation IDs and immutable event records with versioned contracts.
Record model/agent/config/prompt/capability hashes, timestamps, costs, evidence links, decisions and status.
Support sanitized trace replay without reexecuting irreversible actions.
Operator can explain why a capability was chosen for a task.
Secrets and restricted content are redacted before trace export.
Do not claim fully reproducible model outputs without matching provider snapshot.
Audit logs must be access-controlled and retention bounded.
Create staged candidate changes with baseline, targeted eval and sealed holdout comparison.
Require semantic compatibility, risk checks, approvals and instant rollback for promotion.
Monitor post-promotion regressions and record attribution of improvement.
Candidate that increases unsafe tool-use accuracy regression fails promotion.
A small-model-optimized prompt can be rolled back without affecting ledger.
Never auto-promote permission increases.
Self-judged improvement alone is insufficient evidence.
Support user-scoped install, config doctor, backup/restore and process supervisor by OS.
Profile RAM/CPU/storage, sleep behavior, proxy, corporate CA, offline setup and approved provider allowlists.
Keep durable engine behind port and distinguish local dev reliability from enterprise HA.
Windows/macOS/Linux native smoke without Docker.
Offline enterprise profile refuses disallowed egress and works with supplied authorized assets.
Never bundle unlicensed third-party binaries.
One laptop sleeping means no background execution without remote always-on worker.
Capture authentic sender, channel, conversation thread, request ID and delivery intent.
Use inbox/outbox, retries, idempotency where provided, expiry and uncertain-delivery reconciliation.
Treat notification preferences and channels as user-specific, not provider-wide.
Fake Slack HMAC/replay and rate-limit tests pass locally without Slack credentials.
Real-provider absence returns NOT_VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, not validated.
Do not send to a guessed user or channel.
Do not claim receipt when provider times out after possible send.
Compile immutable system constraints, selected interaction profile, active capacity contracts and bounded context into a prompt receipt.
Validate declarative statechart states/edges/guards; reject unsafe or unreachable transitions and missing terminal paths.
Expose propose/validate/render/simulate/diff/promote/rollback with review gates; never eval executable expressions from YAML.
Given profile change, compiled prompt/statechart hash changes predictably and rollback restores previous digest.
Malformed machine with dead-end state, privilege-changing guard or infinite unbudgeted cycle is rejected.
A generated prompt cannot grant tool permission.
An LLM-generated transition proposal cannot enter production without semantic checks.
Build small, typed per-decision context envelopes with current goal, state, relevant history, tool descriptions and uncertainty.
Calibrate model support and empirical routing performance separately by model/provider/config hash.
Use deterministic fallback, repair budget and optional stronger model escalation while preserving task ownership.
Small model handles greeting without tool calling and complex task routes to safe capability discovery.
Context update after user correction changes only relevant prompt segment and keeps validated instructions stable.
Huge context window is not evidence of better reasoning.
Prompt truncation must not discard security or ownership facts.
